Synopsis:
    Oscar-winning director Laura Poitras and co-director Rachel Lauren Mueller premiered a 25-minute documentary at the Venice Film Festival covering ICE deportation raids in Minneapolis. The film documents community volunteer networks tracking ICE movements, the death of two U.S. citizens during confrontations, and the story of a Mexican man evading authorities. The filmmakers argue community resistance was effective, with ICE ultimately withdrawing 80% of its agents from the operation.
